notes.title: Protocol Aftertime Early Access Release
notes.content:
[h2]Hello, travellers![/h2]

It's finally time to release Protocol Aftertime in Early Access. For the first week, we'll start with 10% off. 

We are really interested in what you think of the game. Feel free to leave a comment, review or join our [url=https://discord.gg/ZwfMmESRWc]Discord[/url].

We wish you a lot of fun and a wonderous trip!
